crystal_of_time.name: Crystal of Time
description: A crystal from Ylarus, the God of Time.
It enables you to reset time to 07:30.

key_honeywood_basement.name: Basement key
description: Key to the elder's basement, given to you by the elder himself.

scroll_of_orc_obedience.name: Scroll of Orc Obedience
description: Makes an orc follow your command unconditionally.
This specific scroll only works in Honeywood Forest.

horse_medicine.name: Horse Medicine
description: A medicine made by Elenora for Enopa.

tow_rope.name: Tow Rope
description: A strong rope which can be used by a horse.

letter_to_fairy_shop.name: Letter to the Fairy Shop
description: A letter from the village elder to the Fairy Shop.

key_lastdenn_jail.name: Cell door 2 key
description: Key to Lastdenn Jail cell door 2.

letter_to_santino.name: Letter to Father Santino
description: A letter from Garrin to Father Santino about a ghost repelling item.

ghost_repeller.name: Ghost repeller
description: A holy staff from Father Santino that makes ghosts interactable.
It doesn't work on possessed people though.
